Landed as Gerrit 3118 (commit 6a0e3c9afcd, patchset 1): LLM-Review +1, Verified +1 (CI run 40367512676), 0 unresolved; submitted at revision 6a0e3c9afcdf6bd1a0e322d47183535ece5d292e; checked 2026-10-26 10:43-10:44 PDT.

Evidence (measured on the pre-push commit, 2026-10-26 before 09:24 PDT):
1. AC1: tests/unit/test_conftest_windows_skip_rule.py was red before the helper existed ('module has no attribute _linux_host_script_skip_reason', 1 error in collection) and is green after: on merged main 25 passed (7 win32 cases naming the ticket, 14 linux/darwin None cases, 4 unrelated-path cases).
2. AC2: Linux collection of tests/scripts and tests/unit with -m 'not integration and not external': 17132 node ids before, 17157 after; 0 removed, 25 added, all 25 in the new test file; with a probe plugin on Linux 0 items carry a skip naming this ticket.
3. AC3 (sys.platform patched to win32 by a throwaway probe plugin, not committed): 492 items carry a skip naming this ticket; 492 items are under the 7 fragments; 0 skip-named items outside them and 0 fragment items without it. Skips from other causes were not counted.
4. AC4: make verify (09:24 PDT start; 0:52:41): 17 failed, 19771 passed, 107 skipped; all 17 failures under tests/unit/reconciler (known arm64 pandoc set). Ruff check and format, C901 on tests/conftest.py, check_complexity_baseline (new=0 increased=0) and check_mechanism_delta (new=0 increased=0) were clean.

Effect estimate: of the 1679 distinct red node ids in scheduled run 40284466555, 455 lie under the 7 fragments (37 of the 492 skipped tests were not red there). This matches ids from a Linux collection against a Windows log, so it is approximate. Unverified: the resulting Windows red count; that needs a Windows sweep after this lands.

Advisory from the review bot: the collection-hook glue has no committed test (checked only by the probe in 3). Not fixed here, because a new patchset resets both votes and needs another make verify; filed as defensive-sundried-iggypops (0559-f639-508d-4ac8), discovered_from this task.
